_provenance.source: FAA d-TPP cycle 2610 approach plates (rendered pages data/sources/raw/dtpp_2610_txt/P_*-1.png)
_provenance.method: Profile-view altitudes were read from magnified crops; underline = minimum altitude, overline = maximum, both = mandatory (per FAA chart symbology). Plan-view route labels ("2000 NoPT 096 deg (8.1)") are italic numbers without under/overline lines in the plan view and are recorded as the leg minimum altitude with view="plan view route label...". HUMAN TRANSCRIPTION - verify against the PDFs before any real use.
_provenance.missed_approach_climbs: Missed-approach climb altitudes are not repeated here; see missedApproachText in kacy-procedures.json.
_provenance.correction: ILS Z / LOC Z 13: the glideslope intercept altitude at the FAF MAYBN is 1600 (underlined, lightning bolt), not 1700. ILS/LOC-DME 31: PRSTY 1700.
